hypotheses.text: If Ruben Saldo (CB) had been 3 m closer to Kai Nakamura, the shot would likely have been prevented by reducing Nakamura's shooting space and forcing a lower-quality attempt.
If Lukas Hagen (CB) had been 5 m closer to Kai Nakamura, his positioning could have blocked the shooting lane or applied pressure to lower the chance of scoring.
